evals.prompt: Create a skill that turns my raw meeting notes (markdown bullet lists) into a weekly status report with three sections: Done, In Progress, Blockers. I want Claude to produce the same report shape every time. Don't interview me and don't run any tests or evals — just author the complete skill folder.
evals.expected_output: A complete skill folder whose SKILL.md prose follows the writing style guide: imperative instructions, active voice, one term per concept, no vague delegating words, reasons attached to non-obvious rules, pushy third-person description, at least one verbatim example.
assertions: no-and-then-compound-steps: SKILL.md prose contains no 'and then' compound instructions (guide Rule 3)
no-vague-delegating-words: no 'appropriately', 'as needed', 'various', 'deal with', 'handle errors' in instructions (Rule 6)
no-allcaps-directives: no bare MUST/NEVER/ALWAYS caps directives in body; rules carry reasons (Rule 9)
description-has-trigger-contexts: frontmatter description is third-person and names when-to-use contexts (Rule 10)
has-concrete-example: at least one concrete input-to-output example (Rule 11)
no-passive-procedures: procedural instructions are active voice with a visible actor (Rules 1-2)
defines-exact-output-template: skill pins an exact output template with placeholder slots for its recurring deliverable
